chunks: O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness and a bearer of happy tidings and an admonisher,
ai.seo_question: What are the three main roles of the Prophet mentioned in Surah Al-Ahzab verse 45?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the Prophet's role as a divine witness (Shahid) who testifies to the truth of monotheism and the prophethood of his successors. The triad of roles—glad tidings, warning, and witness—underscores the comprehensive nature of his mission, linking the spiritual comfort for the faithful with the accountability of the disbelievers. This verse serves as a foundational text for understanding the Prophet's authority and his function as an intercessor on the Day of Judgment.
